**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.01` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Define permitted discovery methods, request limits, source terms and what may be recorded from each source class.

## Deliverables

- Discovery protocol with permitted and prohibited methods
- Per-source-class terms-of-use review template

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/SOURCE_RIGHTS.md`
- `docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- The terms of use for each source class are captured with URL and access date

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each source class has a documented permitted method and a recordable-fields list
- [ ] Scraping without permission is explicitly prohibited
- [ ] Policy approved in the decision register

## Non-goals

- Running crawlers or bulk downloads
- Collecting dataset contents

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.01.T1` Draft the protocol
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T1.S1` List source classes
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T1.S2` Define permitted methods per class
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T1.S3` Define request-rate and attribution rules
- [ ] `DATA-02.01.T2` Terms review template
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T2.S1` Create the template
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T2.S2` Pilot it on two source classes
  - [ ] `DATA-02.01.T2.S3` Record open questions
